result:
I ran all 14 queries against the input files and each gave a sensible answer. I didn't check the Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q6, Q9, Q12 or Q14 answers against the raw data by hand.

- **Q4:** the result is axios, eslint, express and jest.
- **Q7:** the answer is 5.
- **Q12:** the answer is false.

Q8 and Q9 each needed a rewrite after the first try failed, and the queries below are the rewritten ones.

Q1: filter ~(and (/active | eq true) (at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin")) * /email | sort
Q2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") * /items | flat | * (mul /price /qty) | sum | round 2
Q3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (/assignee | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy * count
Q4: [(at :dependencies | coalesce {}) (at :devDependencies | coalesce {})] * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * /0 | sort
Q5: lines * split " " | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) * /2 | distinct | sort
Q6: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(/2 | ne "") * {:dept /1 :s (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~/dept * (* /s | avg | round 1)
Q7: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Date ","cherry"] * lower | distinct | count
Q8: /services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) * {:n /name :p (at :net | coalesce {} | at :port | coalesce 80)} | sort ~([(/p | desc) /n]) * [/n (/p | print)] * join ":"
Q9: groupBy ~/user * count | entries * {:user (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /user]) | take 3
Q10: * {:id /id :t /title :c (at :comments | coalesce 0)} | sort ~([(/c | desc) /id]) | take 3 * /t
Q11: lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | filter ~(trim | startsWith "#" | not) * (split "=" | [(/0) (drop 1 | join "=")]) | filter ~(/0 | startsWith "DB_") * [(/0 | drop 3 | lower | keyword) /1] | tag ::map
Q12: filter ~(/total | gt 100) | every ~(at :shipped_at | ne null)
Q13: * (at :tags | coalesce []) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort
Q14: groupBy ~/endpoint | vals | filter ~(count | gte 2) * {:endpoint (/0/endpoint) :count count :avgMs (* (at :latency_ms) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 0)} | sort ~/endpoint
